state.tweet: Love waiting 40 minutes for a bus. Great start to the day.

ironic.instructions: Is this tweet ironic or sarcastic? It is when the literal words mean the opposite of what the author means (praising something bad, e.g. 'Love waking up early on a Saturday #not'), or when the author points out an ironic situation. A hashtag such as #not, #sarcasm or #irony at the end usually marks the tweet as ironic: read the words as meant the other way. A tweet that only talks about sarcasm or irony without being ironic itself is not ironic.
